department: Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering

deadline.value: International applicants apply (with all documents) by March 31, 2027 for September 2027 entry; the domestic deadline is May 31. Incomplete applications are declined.
deadline.quote: Outcomes will be communicated to applicants approximately two months after the deadline. | International Deadline Fall Term September May 31 Documents due: May 31 March 31 Documents due: March 31

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A faculty member must agree to supervise you; apply only after a potential supervisor shows interest.
supervisor.quote: Supervisor approval is required to apply | This program requires you to have a supervisor.

funding.value: Most thesis-based engineering graduate students are funded; CAD 22,000-25,000/year for PhD, often from supervisors' research grants.
funding.quote: Most thesis-based graduate students in the College of Engineering receive funding during their studies (e.g., scholarships, stipends, awards, research fellowships and teaching assistantships). | $22,000-$25,000/year (Ph.D.)

entry_route.value: PhD entry normally needs a master's (70%+); direct entry from a four-year honours degree (80%+) is possible for exceptionally strong students.
entry_route.quote: A master's degree, or equivalent, from a recognized university in a relevant academic discipline to the proposed field of study | With the recommendation of the unit, direct entry Ph.D. admission is available to exceptionally strong students
